title: PatternSyntaxException on @Path definition with regexp
body:
## Describe the bug
`@Path("/{pin: [A-Z][A-Z][A-Z0-9]{9}[0-9]}")` is not parsed correctly

### Expected behavior
regexp should work

## To Reproduce
create project with quarkus-resteasy-reactive and resource:
```java
@Path("")
@Authenticated
public class Api {
    @GET
    @Path("/{pin: [A-Z][A-Z][A-Z0-9]{9}[0-9]}")
    public Uni<String> hello1(){
        return Uni.createFrom().optional(Optional.of("Hello, World 1!"));
    }

    @GET
    public Uni<String> hello2(){
        return Uni.createFrom().optional(Optional.of("Hello, World 2!"));
    }
}```

1. Create project
2. curl localhost:8080

openjdk version "14.0.1" 2020-04-14
tested with 1.13.0.Final and 1.12.0.Final
extensions: quarkus-resteasy-reactive, quarkus-elytron-security-properties-file
